verdict.rationale: First-party docs list speech-to-text, text-to-speech and hands-free voice and video calls as features (docs-24). They also describe a hands-free conversation loop where you talk, the AI answers and the reply is read back (docs-63), with replies spoken sentence by sentence as they stream (docs-44). Together these cover all three parts of the story: transcription, spoken replies and live voice conversation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on the main web UI's STT/TTS configuration and provider options (the most detailed voice docs come from the Computer ecosystem pages).
